name: cabin-viewer
features: 3D model of the 14 by 20 lofted barn loads with exterior, interior, thermal and kitchen tabs.
Exterior view picks each wall, iso, top down, auto spin and open doors.
Interior view shows lofts and walls with look up, level and auto pan.
Thermal tab picks envelope assemblies with R value and price, and the heat overlay and tally recompute live.
Layer toggles show or hide shell, loft, water, electric, kitchen and restroom.
